derivedFrom: The 2,864-page list was recomputed from the initial unmodified per-page results at output/multidevice-20260714/local/cts/results.json, output/multidevice-20260714/mac-mini-m4/cts/results.json, and output/multidevice-20260714/genesis-m1/cts-chrome150/results.json, and cross-checked against the Echo and Mac diagnostic per-page summaries. The retained Genesis diagnostic summary is aggregate-only and is not the per-page source.
method: Pages were classified by top-level CTS path prefix: conformance/ is the WebGL 1.0 / GLSL ES 1.00 suite; conformance2/ is the WebGL 2.0 / GLSL ES 3.00 suite; deqp/ are dEQP GLES3 shader-language pages folded into the WebGL 2.0 CTS. conformance2/ and deqp/ are jointly treated as the WebGL 2-specific scope.

initialFullRun.note: The sole WebGL2-scope failure (bool-type-cast-bug-uint-ivec-uvec.html) was one of the six pages that failed identically on all three systems in the initial-full-unmodified stage.

afterBooleanUniformFix.caveat: Confirmed only by the targeted six-page Echo M4 rerun (runtime-fix-targeted-unmodified stage in data/cts-evidence-stages.json), not by a full three-system unmodified rerun of all 1,976 WebGL2-scope pages together.

remainingDefects.note: Both open items after the Boolean-uniform fix -- the reserved-identifier runtime defect and the contradictory double-underscore fixture -- are confined to the legacy conformance/ (WebGL 1 / GLSL ES 1.00) suite. Neither affects a WebGL 2 / GLSL ES 3.00 page.
